This pertains to your letter seeking clarification on the opinion previously rendered by this Department addressed to the Sangguniang Bayan of Altavas, Aklan regarding the Presidency of the Liga ng mga Barangay in the Municipality of Altavas, Aklan. In reply thereto, please be informed that our opinion dated 30 September 2011 informing the Sangguniang Bayan of Altavas, Aklan regarding the assumption of Punong Barangay Joel Mayor as ex-offcio member of the Sangguniang Bayan of Aklan was based on the representation of the letter sender Punong Barangay Joel Mayor and on the documents furnished to this Department which includes the Liga ng mga Barangay National Executive Board Resolution dated 16 December 2010 declaring Punong Barangay Joel F. Mayor as the duly elected Liga President of Altavas, Province of Aklan Chapter. This Department was not furnished with a copy of the more recent Resolution of the Liga ng mga Barangay National Executive Board dated 20 January 2011 which granted the Motion for Reconsideration filed by Punong Barangay Hernan Catuiran. In the said recent Resolution, the Liga ng mga Barangay National Executive Board, Punong Barangay Hernan Catuiran was already declared as the duly elected Liga President of Altavas, Province of Aklan. Upon perusal of the documents you have forwarded to this Department, this Department found out that on 20 January 2011, the Office of the National President, Liga ng mga Barangay issued a Certificate of Confirmation to Punong Barangay Hernan Catuiran. We were also recently informed that on 20 September 2011, the 5 National Liga Executive Board issued a Resolution remanding the Motion for Reconsideration of Punong Barangay Joel Mayor to the Regional Chapter of Region VI. Therefore, based on the Resolution dated 20 January 2011 of the National Executive Board, Liga ng mga Barangay sa Pilipinas, declaring Punong Barangay Catuiran as the duly elected Liga President of Altavas, Province of Aklan Chapter and based on the Certificate of Confirmation in favor of Punong Barangay Catuiran, this Department is now of the view that Punong Barangay Catuiran may now assume as ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan of Altavas, Aklan pending Resolution of the Motion for

-2- Reconsideration of Punong Barangay of Punong Barangay Joel Mayor by the Liga ng mga Barangay sa Pilipinas Regional Chapter, Region VI. Hope we have addressed your concern accordingly. Very truly yours, . JES Di Vice Mayor Joly A. Solita Presiding Officer Sangguniang Bayan Altavas, Aklan Mr. Joel F. Mayor President Municipal Liga ng mga Barangay Altavas Chapter Altavas, Aklan Dir.
